# Confirm draft recovery time stays accurate after a tab is backgrounded

## What & Why
Browsers can throttle timers for background tabs. Verify that the visible recovery cue and the actual expiry stay aligned when a user briefly leaves the app and returns.

## Done looks like
- Browser coverage backgrounds the page while an answer draft notice is visible, then returns to it.
- The displayed time never increases and the notice expires at the intended deadline.
- The same behavior is covered for opportunity drafts where practical.
